Here we can see last week's bonuses that have been transferred to a cash account. You can use gift codes to pay for a new product package. There are also other options available as credit cards and bank wires, but today we will see how the gift code payment option will work. So at first you will have to login to your account, where you have enough money on your cash account, then you go to gift code page, where you can buy a gift code. So at the moment, we will have to pay for the purchase of a package which costs 530 euros. This is a track and trace package, so we will choose this button. Here we will choose how we want to pay... ...for your gift code We will use Cash account as we have enough money there Now you have to type in your security password for your transactions Without transaction password, nobody can steal your money Or make any transfers from your account. So now the gift code is paid. The gift code is here, those numbers and letters. We just copy those numbers and letters. Now we can logout from sponsors page and we will enter the page of the new client, who wants to purchase a product package. So type in username, password, login. Here we can see a newly registered place with no money or tokens or one coins on account. So what we need to do is to make an upgrade. Choose upgrade package. This person wants to purchase traders package with 500 euros. And the one-time activation fee of 30 euros will be added. So in total, it will be 530. And as we noticed, the gift code that we made was for the 530 euros. So you can't use this gift code for any other purchase except this one. So here we will make the decision how do we obey as I said we have credit card option for China, china-union, perfect money and bank wire but bank wires will not be made from this page. At this point we use gift codes as this is the fastest and the most secure way to pay. So gift code has been selected... ...and now we are going to paste the code that we captured before here... ...and again make sure that the new person is the right person person wants to purchase this package. You must redeem this gift code as well. We can see with the positive answer that the gift code was accepted. After few seconds you can see that the package is upgraded. it, it's delivered, we will make sure from the dashboard that you have received the 5,000 tokens and the gold account has been also updated and the last thing is to send those tokens for mining, so we need tokens to mine one coins and until up the end in the April we can use reducet cost mining or automining mining will work for yourself with a reduced cost in mining page you select minimining automatically confirm yes, and send data to server Pressing submit and yes And that's it, you are automatically mining It may take a few minutes, maybe Until the system we'll make all the necessary updates But you can see that the submit is ok And if you return in a few minutes, maybe, until the system will make all the necessary updates, but you can see that the submit is okay. And if you return in a few minutes you can see that your mining has been activated. Also we can see already that all tokens have been sent to mining, so that's it! Congratulations a new person has just purchased abroad package and you have received bonuses if you are sponsored direct sales bonus a network bonus when a new member purchase a bloody package thank you for watching me and see you in next time for more tips and tips!

textual.observation: The source links weekly or network bonuses and marketing income to purchasing another person's package or to a new member's package purchase.

evidence.quote: using weekly earnings from marketing income
you can use those bonuses to pay for somebody else's product package
you have received bonuses if you are sponsored direct sales bonus a network bonus when a new member purchase a bloody package

textual.context: Presented as a how-to or product tutorial; whether the speaker is endorsing, demonstrating, or merely describing the arrangement is not independently established.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised bonuses are tied to package purchases and, in ASR_0003, to a new member's purchase, creating a reward-and-recruitment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that any bonus was actually paid, that the arrangement is deceptive, or that any person incurred a loss. Some ASR wording may be inaccurate.

textual.observation: The walkthrough instructs a user to fund a 530-euro package from a cash account, create a gift code, enter a transaction password, and paste and redeem the code on a newly registered client's account.

evidence.quote: a package which costs 530 euros
you will have to login to your account, where you have enough money on your cash account
type in your security password for your transactions
paste the code that we captured before here
You must redeem this gift code as well

textual.context: Operational payment walkthrough involving a sponsor account and a new client's account; the records do not establish the parties' roles or authorization.
textual.potential_relevance: A specific payment and credential-entry sequence is connected to transferring a 530-euro package payment through a gift code to another account, making the money-flow relationship relevant for later review.
textual.limitations: No transaction, recipient identity, authorization, or completed payment is independently verified by these records.

textual.observation: The package-upgrade process is described as delivering 5,000 tokens, sending those tokens to mining, and activating mining automatically after the purchase.

evidence.quote: you have received the 5,000 tokens
send those tokens for mining
you are automatically mining
your mining has been activated

textual.context: The claimed result is presented within an instructional demonstration and congratulatory narration, not as an independently verified outcome.
textual.potential_relevance: A concrete token and mining outcome is presented as following payment and package upgrade, linking a promised asset or destination to a financial action.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the tokens existed, had value, could be withdrawn, or generated any return.

visual.observation: A branded dashboard displays “DIRECTLY SPONSORED 61” and “PENDING SPONSORED 22” alongside “BONUS EARNED THIS WEEK,” “TOTAL BONUS EARNED,” points balances, and a countdown labeled “UNTIL NEXT BONUS ROUND.”
visual.context: Branded rewards dashboard; whether the screen is promotional, instructional, or demonstrative is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed sponsorship or recruitment status is visually linked to bonus and points metrics and to a timed bonus round.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show what sponsors were asked to do, whether the displayed rewards are redeemable, or whether the figures are genuine.

visual.observation: A “Pay gift code” interface shows a listed euro-denominated price, a gift-code field, several payment methods, and the notice “This gift code will be activated once your payment registered.”
visual.context: Transaction and gift-code purchase interface; broader context is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: Payment through the listed methods is explicitly linked to activation of the gift code.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the payment recipient, whether payment occurred, the code’s value or use, or whether activation happened.

visual.observation: A “Pay package” screen shows “Package: Trader” with a listed price and payment-method choices, while a dashboard notice states that the account is “currently PENDING” and that payment registration is associated with activation and/or a product package; the notice also refers to contacting support or sending transaction proof if payment was made.
visual.context: Visible account-status and package-payment workflow with a pending-status notice.
visual.potential_relevance: A package payment is visually tied to account activation, with follow-up contact or transaction-proof steps presented when payment registration is pending.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the full notice, the recipient of any payment or proof, whether payment was completed, or the activation outcome.

visual.observation: A mining page displays “YOUR POOLS,” “COINS FOUND,” “YOUR SHARE OF COINS,” “TOKENS AVAILABLE FOR MINING,” a “SUBMIT” button, “AUTOMATICALLY MINING,” and daily mining-capacity percentages.
visual.context: Mining/account interface; whether the screen is a live account view or demonstration is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: Token submission or automatic-mining settings are visually linked to a stated share of coins and mining-output fields.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish that mining occurred, that tokens were transferred, or that any coins were received.

visual.observation: A stage display identifies “OneCoin TeamEstonia,” labels the event “MINING EXTRAVAGANZA,” and shows an email address and a Facebook group destination.
visual.context: Event-branded presentation context with visible contact destinations; the nature of the affiliation is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed team or event identity is linked to specific contact and social-media destinations for audience follow-up.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish ownership, authorization, authenticity, or what action recipients were expected to take.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material is framed as an instructional walkthrough of the gift-code payment process.

evidence.quote: today we will see how the gift code payment option will work
thank you for watching me and see you in next time for more tips and tips

textual_context_notes.observation: The gift code is described as restricted to one specified purchase, and the package includes a one-time activation fee.

evidence.quote: So you can't use this gift code for any other purchase except this one.
the one-time activation fee of 30 euros will be added

textual_context_notes.observation: The narration includes an explicit security assurance about using a transaction password.

evidence.quote: Without transaction password, nobody can steal your money

visual_context_notes.observation: Several frames show a branded OneCoin dashboard with account balances, bonus metrics, countdowns, package menus, and mining-related sections.
A visible dashboard notice states that the account is “currently PENDING” and refers to payment registration before activation or product-package access.
The dashboard visibly includes a qualification statement that the account does not yet qualify for a leadership rank.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively demonstrates paying 530 EUR for a product package, converting the package into tokens, and activating mining while presenting weekly and network bonuses as benefits of participation. It also encourages recruitment by stating that the presenter receives direct-sales and network bonuses when a new member purchases a package.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because purchasing a paid product package is directly linked to receiving tokens and activating mining. S06 is also supported because earnings are explicitly described as direct-sales and network bonuses generated when a new member purchases a package.
